/* ── kill rmarkdown TOC column ── */

/* ── Back link ── */
.back-link { font-size:0.88em; margin-bottom:20px; }

/* ── Page hero ── */
.page-hero {
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px;
  padding:24px 28px; border-radius:14px; margin:0 0 32px 0;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg, #27ae6018 0%, #27ae6008 100%);
  border:1px solid #27ae6030;
}
.page-hero-icon {
  width:52px; height:52px; border-radius:12px;
  background:#27ae60; display:flex; align-items:center;
  justify-content:center; font-size:1.5em; flex-shrink:0;
}
.page-hero h1 { font-size:1.8em; font-weight:700; color:#2c3e50; margin:0 0 4px 0; }
.page-hero p  { font-size:0.9em; color:#777; margin:0; }

/* ── Section dividers ── */
.sec-divider {
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; margin:36px 0 16px 0;
}
.sec-divider-icon {
  width:32px; height:32px; border-radius:8px; background:#27ae60;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  font-size:0.95em; flex-shrink:0;
}
.sec-divider h2 {
  font-size:1.15em; font-weight:700; color:#2c3e50; margin:0;
}
.sec-divider hr { flex:1; border:none; border-top:1px solid #e5e5e5; }

/* ── Grant cards ── */
.grant-card {
  background:#fff; border:1px solid #e4e9f0; border-radius:10px;
  padding:16px 20px; margin-bottom:12px;
  border-left:4px solid #27ae60;
  box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
  transition:box-shadow .15s;
}
.grant-card:hover { box-shadow:0 3px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); }
.grant-card-top { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.grant-years {
  font-size:0.75em; font-weight:700; padding:3px 10px;
  background:#27ae6018; color:#27ae60; border-radius:20px;
  white-space:nowrap; flex-shrink:0;
}
.grant-title { font-weight:700; color:#2c3e50; font-size:0.97em; }
.grant-desc  { font-size:0.87em; color:#666; margin-top:5px; line-height:1.6; }

/* ── Student cards ── */
.student-grid {
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(260px,1fr));
  gap:14px; margin-bottom:8px;
}
.student-card {
  background:#fff; border:1px solid #e4e9f0; border-radius:10px;
  padding:14px 16px; box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
  transition:box-shadow .15s;
}
.student-card:hover { box-shadow:0 3px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); }
.student-card-top { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:6px; }
.student-name { font-weight:700; color:#2c3e50; font-size:0.95em; }
.student-badge {
  font-size:0.68em; font-weight:700; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:20px;
}
.badge-phd    { background:#fce4ec; color:#c62828; }
.badge-master { background:#e3f2fd; color:#1565c0; }
.badge-bachelor { background:#e8f5e9; color:#2e7d32; }
.student-year { font-size:0.78em; color:#aaa; margin-bottom:4px; }
.student-topic { font-size:0.82em; color:#666; line-height:1.5; }

/* ── Conference list ── */
.conf-entry {
  display:flex; gap:16px; padding:10px 0;
  border-bottom:1px solid #f0f0f0; align-items:flex-start;
}
.conf-entry:last-child { border-bottom:none; }
.conf-year {
  font-size:0.75em; font-weight:700; color:#27ae60;
  min-width:38px; padding-top:2px; flex-shrink:0;
}
.conf-body { font-size:0.87em; color:#555; line-height:1.55; }
.conf-body strong { color:#2c3e50; }

/* ── Award card ── */
.award-card {
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#27ae6012,#27ae6006);
  border:1px solid #27ae6035; border-radius:10px;
  padding:16px 20px; margin-bottom:12px;
}
.award-card-title { font-weight:700; color:#2c3e50; margin-bottom:4px; font-size:0.97em; }
.award-card-desc  { font-size:0.87em; color:#555; line-height:1.6; }

/* ── Media entry ── */
.media-entry {
  display:flex; gap:14px; align-items:flex-start;
  padding:10px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #f0f0f0;
}
.media-entry:last-child { border-bottom:none; }
.media-year  { font-size:0.75em; font-weight:700; color:#27ae60; min-width:38px; flex-shrink:0; padding-top:2px; }
.media-body  { font-size:0.87em; color:#555; line-height:1.55; }
.media-body a { color:#27ae60; text-decoration:none; font-weight:500; }
.media-body a:hover { text-decoration:underline; }
</style>
